pictures.scene: Russian icon, Christ Enthroned in Majesty — the Lord seated on the throne with the open book in His hand and the hosts of heaven around Him, the LORD reigns let the earth rejoice, let the distant shores be glad
pictures.name: pd_ikoon_regeert

pictures.scene: Fra Angelico, The Transfiguration — Christ standing in the white blaze with His arms spread while the disciples fall back dazzled, clouds and darkness surround Him, righteousness and justice are His throne's foundation
pictures.name: pd_angelico_wolken

pictures.scene: Benjamin West, Destruction of the Beast and the False Prophet — the rider going out in the flame of heaven while his enemies are swept down before him, fire goes before Him and consumes His foes on every side
pictures.name: pd_west_vuur

pictures.scene: Thomas Cole, Tornado in an American Forest — the great trees torn and bent under the black storm with the light breaking behind them, His lightning illuminates the world, the earth sees and trembles
pictures.name: pd_cole_bliksem

pictures.scene: Albert Bierstadt, Mount Vesuvius at Midnight — the mountain running with fire into the dark bay, the mountains melt like wax at the presence of the LORD
pictures.name: pd_bierstadt_bergen

pictures.scene: Abraham Hondius, The Annunciation to the Shepherds — the sky torn open over the fields with the angel calling down to the startled herdsmen, before the Lord of all the earth, the heavens proclaim His righteousness, all the peoples see His glory
pictures.name: pd_hondius_hemel

lines.text: The LORD reigns, let the earth rejoice;
let the distant shores be glad.
righteousness and justice are His throne’s foundation.
and consumes His foes on every side.
at the presence of the LORD,
before the Lord of all the earth.
all the peoples see His glory.
